_scoring.effective_dates: 11/11 correct (act level; 2 section-scoped proviso gaps noted)
_scoring.recall_method: denominator = stored real records (correct+wrong) + blind items with no stored record; large omnibus laws were blind-listed by section, not item by item

_classes.name: conforming-word or citation-only reprint stored as a record
_classes.rule: packet text -> clean text with new-matter mask; flag records whose quote span contains 1-4 new-matter words, all in {justices, or, they, their, chairperson, his, her, article, title, chapter, the, an, a, such, incarcerated individual, ...}

_classes.name: study-content list items stored as separate records
_classes.rule: deliverable_type=='study or audit' and quote matches ^(Determine|Assess|Identify|Evaluate|Recommend|Examine|Review|Analy[sz]e|Investigate|Study|Compare)\b and no shall/must/may in quote

_classes.name: appointee-qualification lead stored as a duty per appointer
_classes.rule: quote matches (?i)members (appointed|of the \w+) shall include,? but not be limited to|shall include at least one|at least one of each of the following

_classes.name: offset deadline anchored to the act date instead of the Part/section date
_classes.rule: deadline_kind=='days_after_effective' and deadline_offset amount>0 and deadline_date<=record effective_date

_classes.name: named-class local actor left Unspecified
_classes.rule: agency=='Unspecified' and actor_raw matches (?i)local correctional facilit|public entity|county jail|any municipality|local (government|agency)

_classes.name: prohibition on the government actor stored as a power
_classes.rule: record in powers/*.json whose quote matches (?i)\b(may not|shall not|no \w+ (shall|may))\b before any 'provided'

_classes.name: owner-liability, penalty cap or evidentiary rule in camera laws stored as a record
_classes.rule: quote matches (?i)liability of the owner .{0,40}shall not exceed|shall not be deemed a conviction|shall be liable for monetary penalties|lessee of such vehicle|be used in such criminal action|shall be subject to liability

_classes.name: relocated duplicate quote under a different citation
_classes.rule: group by (matter_id, agency, quote); flag groups with more than one distinct citation (all but the first record)

_classes.name: section-scoped proviso date not applied to the section's records
_classes.rule: law raw_clause or Part clause matches 'section (\w+) of this act shall take effect on the' while record effective_date equals the act/Part date; needs citation-to-section mapping

2025-S10058-01.quote: the village of Croton-on-Hudson is hereby authorized to establish a demonstration program imposing monetary liability on the owner of a vehicle for failure of an operator thereof to comply with posted maximum speed limits in a school speed zone within such village

2025-S10058-02.quote: Such demonstration program shall empower the village of Croton-on-Hudson to install photo speed violation monitoring systems within no more than three school speed zones within such village at any one time and to operate such systems within such zones

2025-S10058-03.quote: In selecting a school speed zone in which to install and operate a photo speed violation monitoring system, the village shall consider criteria including, but not limited to, the speed data, crash history, and the roadway geometry applicable to such school speed zone.

2025-S10058-05.quote: The village shall install signs giving notice that a photo speed violation monitoring system is in use to be mounted on advance warning signs notifying motor vehicle operators of such upcoming school speed zone and/or on speed limit signs applicable within such school speed zone, in conformance with standards established in the MUTCD.
2025-S10058-05.note: Sign duty applies only once the optional program runs systems ('is hereby authorized to establish a demonstration program'); triggered by a precondition, so no on_effective_date deadline.

2025-S10058-06.quote: Operators of photo speed violation monitoring systems shall have completed training in the procedures for setting up, testing, and operating such systems.

2025-S10058-07.quote: Each such operator shall complete and sign a daily set-up log for each such system that such operator operates that (i) states the date and time when, and the location where, the system was set up that day, and (ii) states that such operator successfully performed, and the system passed, the self-tests of such system

2025-S10058-08.quote: The village shall retain each such daily log until the later of the date on which the photo speed violation monitoring system to which it applies has been permanently removed from use or the final resolution of all cases involving notices of liability issued based on photographs, microphotographs, videotape or other recorded images produced by such system.

2025-S10058-09.quote: Each photo speed violation monitoring system shall undergo an annual calibration check performed by an independent calibration laboratory which shall issue a signed certificate of calibration.

2025-S10058-10.quote: The village shall keep each such annual certificate of calibration on file until the final resolution of all cases involving a notice of liability issued during such year which were based on photographs, microphotographs, videotape or other recorded images produced by such photo speed violation monitoring system.

2025-S10058-11.quote: Such demonstration program shall utilize necessary technologies to ensure, to the extent practicable, that photographs, microphotographs, videotape or other recorded images produced by such photo speed violation monitoring systems shall not include images that identify the driver, the passengers, or the contents of the vehicle.

2025-S10058-12.quote: shall be destroyed by the village upon the final resolution of the notice of liability to which such photographs, microphotographs, videotape or other recorded images relate, or one year following the date of issuance of such notice of liability, whichever is later

2025-S10058-13.quote: no public entity or employee, officer or agent thereof shall disclose such information, except that such photographs, microphotographs, videotape or any other recorded images from such systems:

2025-S10058-14.quote: shall be available for inspection and copying and use by the motor vehicle owner and operator for so long as such photographs, microphotographs, videotape or other recorded images are required to be maintained or are maintained by such public entity, employee, officer or agent

2025-S8415-09.quote: All covered facilities in the state shall be required to install, operate, and maintain fixed or stationary cameras sufficient to capture the activities and movement of all persons within each such covered facilities, with the exception of the interior of cells, showers, and toilet areas.
2025-S8415-09.note: 'shall be required to install, operate, and maintain fixed or stationary cameras' is a setup duty with no stated deadline; Part B takes effect 'one year after it shall have become a law'.

2025-S8415-10.quote: For each area in which there is not fixed or stationary camera coverage of the interior of such area, cameras shall be installed, operated, and maintained which capture the ingress and egress of such areas.
2025-S8415-10.note: 'cameras shall be installed, operated, and maintained which capture the ingress and egress' is a setup duty.

2025-S8415-11.quote: Fixed or stationary cameras installed in covered facilities shall capture both audio and visual footage.

2025-S8415-12.quote: Each covered facility shall ensure that all fixed or stationary cameras capture a clear visual of the activities within such covered facility.

2025-S8415-13.quote: The superintendent or warden or their designee shall perform regular assessments and improvements to fixed or stationary camera placement and functionality to ensure complete coverage.

2025-S8415-14.quote: If at any time, the superintendent or warden or their designee becomes aware of any non-functioning fixed or stationary cameras, or any blind spot, such issues shall be documented, investigated and actions shall be taken to remedy the problems that led to incomplete camera coverage or unavailable camera footage.

2025-S8415-15.quote: Fixed or stationary cameras in covered facilities shall operate continuously for twenty-four hours a day.

2025-S8415-16.quote: All fixed or stationary camera footage captured under this section shall be preserved for a minimum of one year.

2025-S8415-17.quote: If there is an allegation or report of any staff misconduct or rule violation, such footage from the time period of such incident shall be preserved for a minimum of five years.

2025-S8415-18.quote: Fixed or stationary camera footage from covered facilities under this section shall be provided upon request if such request is accompanied by a valid subpoena or a court order issued by a court of competent jurisdiction.

2025-S8415-19.quote: Fixed or stationary camera footage relevant to any complaint, investigation, or legal proceeding shall be preserved for a minimum of five years from the date of such complaint or incident.

2025-S8415-20.quote: The office of the inspector general shall determine whether any enforcement actions are warranted for failure to install or maintain adequate fixed or stationary camera coverage, including the recommendation of monetary penalties or corrective actions.

2013-A4327-01.quote: the city of new york is hereby authorized to establish a demonstration program imposing monetary liability on the owner of a vehicle for failure of an operator thereof to comply with posted maximum speed limits in a school speed zone within the city

2013-A4327-02.quote: Such demonstration program shall empower the city to install photo speed violation monitoring systems within no more than twenty school speed zones within the city at any one time and to operate such systems within such zones

2013-A4327-03.quote: In selecting a school speed zone in which to install and operate a photo speed violation monitoring system, the city shall consider criteria including, but not limited to the speed data, crash history, and the roadway geometry applicable to such school speed zone.

2013-A4327-05.quote: The city may install signs giving Notice that a photo speed violation monitoring system is in use to be mounted on advance warning signs notifying motor vehicle operators of such upcoming school speed zone

2013-A4327-06.quote: Operators of photo speed violation monitoring systems shall have completed training in the procedures for setting up, testing, and operating such systems.

2013-A4327-07.quote: Each such operator shall complete and sign a daily set-up log for each such system that he or she operates that (i) states the date and time when, and the location where, the system was set up that day

2013-A4327-08.quote: The city shall retain each such daily log until the later of the date on which the photo speed violation monitoring system to which it applies has been permanently removed from use or the final resolution of all cases involving notices of liability

2013-A4327-09.quote: Each photo speed violation monitoring system shall undergo an annual calibration check performed by an independent calibration laboratory which shall issue a signed certificate of calibration.

2013-A4327-10.quote: The city shall keep each such annual certificate of calibration on file until the final resolution of all cases involving a Notice of liability issued during such year

2013-A4327-11.quote: Such demonstration program shall utilize necessary technologies to ensure, to the extent practicable, that photographs, microphotographs, videotape or other recorded images produced by such photo speed violation monitoring systems shall not include images that identify the driver, the passengers, or the contents of the vehicle.

2013-A4327-12.quote: shall be destroyed by the city upon the final resolution of the Notice of liability to which such photographs, microphotographs, videotape or other recorded images relate, or one year following the date of issuance of such Notice of liability, whichever is later.
